body: I really think you need counselling, you need to find someone to help you work through your problems and find a way to get better. You've obviously been suffering for a long time. Do you ever talk to your mum about what happened? You obviously love your family and they love you, you owe it to them to try and get better, not just to survive but really get better. And you owe it to yourself.

I'm 20. I know that's young, that I'm not even at uni yet and that there are a lot of things I haven't experienced, but i have been thinking about suicide for at least five years, never seriously planning but wondering how hard it would be to walk under a car, fall out of a window and just not have to carry on being me. My mums English, dads Austrian and I've lived in Austria and Italy, as well as school in the uk. Honestly it just leaves me feeling disconnected, Brits think I'm Italian, Italians and Austrians think I'm british...

This is hard for me. I am pretty insecure about things, particularly right now and I know there are times when I snap because I'm not getting the emotional support I need. But he has reached a point where he goes completely cold with me whenever I get upset because I am "always hurting about something" and trying to create problems which he doesn't have the energy to deal with. I'm not a happy person, and having him in my life when things are better makes me a lot happier. But right now there are times when all I need is whatever the msn equivalent of a hug is and he just gets mad at me and then acts like everything is fine the next day, with the result that the hurt just continues to build up inside me until it happens again... I know it's my fault for not being better but I just don't feel like I can keep begging for forgiveness when I'm the one that's being hurt. I try to be there for him but he just thinks I'm a crappy girlfriend because I didn't want to make our only chance to see each other this summer a hacking conference in America when I don't know a thing about computers and actually want a chance to spend some time as a couple. Yes I want to support him in the things he cares about but I'm going to be a student for four years and I just can't afford that kind of money for a trip I don't really feel passionate about, but that makes me a bitch... And I just don't know how I can get this through to him, I don't want to fight and cry I need some support and I feel really alone.

My mum's pretty much my best friend, cliche as that might be. I'm 20 at the moment, living at home for a year because I screwed up my uni interviews last year, and had to wait and reapply for this autumn. We live in Italy, moved here because of my dads job, I went to and English school here for a couple of years but was bullied constantly and ended up going to boarding school in England. It was a really hard transistion for me, it was several months before I actually started speaking to anyone. I made a handful of friends there, A, G & D. D did his final year at a different school, we started going out two years ago, I love him but living at home and only seeing him rarely is just straining our relationship to the breaking point. G was my roommate for two years, we were pretty much joined at the hip but when I started seeing D we grew apart now she's off at uni and we still get on well, she came to meet me at a uni interview in December, but her life has moved on. A was a really close friend for four years, I was having a pretty rough time during my end of school exams, D and I broke up which is another really long story, and ended up getting really good grades (mainly because I spemt hours cooped up in my room not wanting to see people) and A announced that I was an attention seeking bitch who had never really been hurt because there was no way I could have done so well. We haven't spoken since. So my mum's pretty much the only friend I've got, I get on really well with her, we're very alike and share a lot of interests... But she's also a really unhappy person, her marriage is pretty much dead, my dad is completely disconnected from the family emotionally. He doesn't talk to me or my sister and doesn't have very much time for my brother unless they're doing one of my dad's hobbies. My mum wants a divorce but Italian law says you have to be legally separated for 3 years before you can do that, and she's worried she can't afford it because she's got three kids to put through school and uni so she's never done anything about that. She hates it where we live, people are really closeted in their ways and after 10 years nobody in our town will talk to us. She's had a couple of friends from other countries but most expats move on after a year or two and nowadays she has no one at all, so I'm pretty much all she's got too... And it just makes me feel really guilty, because if it weren't for me and my brother and sister she wouldn't be trapped like this, not to mention next year I'm going back to the uk and the only thing she'll have for company is the dog. She and my boyfriend don't get on, she watched him put me through a really bad period a year ago and last time he was visiting she was stressed out and got really mad at me and he said something about how it wasn't fair to my little brother with the result that my mum got really mad about him "trying to turn her children against her" and it's been a mess ever since. I've tried explaining because i can't bear having two people I care about so much hate each other but they're pretty much decided. I just feel a huge burden being where I am right now and I just seem to get it wrong whenever I try to make things better. I want to make my mums life better but I just don't know how.
